content_sections.heading: Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 carries 255 total vacancies for Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Ayah (Helper) posts, distributed across five ICDS projects in the district. A detailed, Anganwadi Centre (AWC)-wise vacancy and category-reservation list for all 255 posts is available as an official annexure to the notification.

content_sections.heading: Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification states that applications are invited from eligible women candidates for the vacant Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Ayah posts. Candidates are directed to the official website wdcw.tg.nic.in for the complete eligibility and application details. Candidates must have passed Intermediate (Class 12) as the minimum qualification. For the Anganwadi Helper/Aya post, if Intermediate-qualified candidates are not available for a particular post, candidates who have passed 10th class (SSC) will be considered eligible, as per the notification. Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official WDCW Telangana website at wdcw.tg.nic.in. Locate the online application link for Nagarkurnool District Anganwadi Teacher/Ayah Recruitment 2026 (Notification No. 185/A/DWO-NGKL/2026). Review the complete eligibility details and vacancy list on the website before applying. Fill in the online application form with the required details. Submit the application before the last date, 21 September 2026 (5:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted in online mode only, through wdcw.tg.nic.in. Only eligible women candidates may apply for these posts, as stated in the notification. The District Collector/Chairman, Nagarkurnool holds full authority to fully cancel or make changes to this notification. Candidates should refer to the official website for full and updated eligibility details, as these are not detailed in the notification itself.

faq.question: Q1. What is Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Welfare Officer (WDCW), Nagarkurnool district, Telangana, to fill 255 vacant Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Ayah posts across 5 ICDS projects, under Notification No. 185/A/DWO-NGKL/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 255 total vacancies - 148 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) and 107 Anganwadi Ayah/Helper (AWH) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
Q4. How can I apply online for Nagarkurnool Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By visiting wdcw.tg.nic.in and submitting the online application before 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Which ICDS projects have Anganwadi vacancies in Nagarkurnool district?
faq.answer: Achampet (77 posts), Balmoor (64 posts), Kalwakurthy (38 posts), Kollapur (34 posts), and Nagarkurnool (42 posts).
